confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not July 2026 observations; no live listings or price pages were consulted. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are moderately grounded. Cocktail and wine are set as rough multiples of the beer anchor (about 3.25x and 3x) because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is least certain: rates vary widely by district, and July falls in the rainy low season, so hotel and hostel anchors may run softer than peak-season rates. The FX figure came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates table, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asia basis, informed by general knowledge of mid-priced regional capitals such as Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur. No web-sourced price data was used; web search was used only for the RBA FX observation.
